subject: Finalizing engagement playbook & go-live readiness — Pacebook
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Susan Lane <susan.lane@pacebook.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Discovery recap — draft engagement playbook attached

Hi Susan — thanks for the time today. Quick recap and next steps as promised. Attached is the first draft of an "Engagement Playbook" (our MAP-equivalent) that lays out milestones, owners, dependencies and a proposed target close / go-live window. High level: 

- Target go-live window: 2026-06-15 to 2026-06-30 (flexible based on security review)
- Key milestones: kick-off, provisioning & network, onboarding models & performance validation, UAT, go-live
- Responsibilities: Pacebook IT (network & security), Redwood (provisioning, model onboarding, ops runbook), Customer Success (enablement)

Next steps: 
1) Review the attached playbook and mark any edits inline — I highlighted the milestones we discussed.
2) Confirm who on Pacebook IT will own the security questionnaire.
3) If the timeline looks tight, call out any hard blockers (legal, procurement, compliance).

Attaching: Pacebook_Engagement_Playbook_v1.2.docx (draft) and SLA summary. I copied Ben (who will own pricing/contract points) and Karthik (technical solutions).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 15-min alignment tomorrow if helpful.

— Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: Pacebook_Engagement_Playbook_v1.2.docx (docx), Redwood_SLA_summary.pdf (pdf)

From: Susan Lane <susan.lane@pacebook.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Elliot <tom.elliot@pacebook.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — draft engagement playbook attached

Naomi — thanks for the doc and the clear recap. A few quick notes from our side after internal review: 

- We like the milestone breakdown; request: can we slide target go-live to the week of 6/22 instead of mid-June? Our security team just flagged a capacity for questionnaire review that likely pushes a week.
- Security questionnaire: Susan Park (secops@pacebook.com) will lead; she asked for Redwood to provide an artifact list (SOC2 evidence, config hardening checklist, network flow diagram).
- Procurement: We have a procurement blackout 6/1–6/7 for contract signings; that means final signature may need to be after 6/8.

Inline edits attached — see a few small phrasing changes and a new dependency row for the security evidence. Can you confirm Redwood can deliver the evidence bundle within 3 business days of the questionnaire?

If yes, we can align on a final sign-off target of 2026-06-22 with go-live the week after (tentative).

Thanks,
Susan Lane
Sr. PM, Platform Integrations | Pacebook
susan.lane@pacebook.com

Attachments: Pacebook_Engagement_Playbook_v1.2-edits.docx (docx)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Susan Lane <susan.lane@pacebook.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — draft engagement playbook attached

Hi Susan — quick answers to the security/technical asks: 

- SOC2 artifacts: we can provide SOC2 Type II report excerpt and relevant control matrices within 2 business days of a signed NDA/LOU for evidence sharing.
- Network flow diagram and config checklist: Redwood infra team can produce a sanitized network flow + configuration hardening checklist in 3 business days.
- On provisioning: we estimate 2 business days to provision reserved capacity once network peering / firewall rules are verified.

Regarding timeline: pushing target sign-off to 2026-06-22 is reasonable assuming procurement can sign between 6/8–6/12 and security questionnaire goes through the week of 6/1. If Pacebook needs the provisioned environment earlier, we can do a soft provisioning to a test VPC (non-production keys) by 6/15 but final prod cutover would still follow the security sign-off.

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pacebook engagement timeline — procurement window note

Team — copying a quick commercial note after reviewing Susan's procurement blackout: 

- If Pacebook cannot sign until 6/8–6/12, recommend we preserve our standard 30-day onboarding credit but confirm the commitment window still lands in June for revenue recognition.
- Proposal: offer a one-time onboarding credit equal to the first month of usage (applied post-signature) to incent moving provisioning earlier to 6/15 for a soft environment. This is discretionary but helpful for maintaining the 6/22 go-live cadence.

Ben — can you prepare a short term-sheet reflecting that credit and the standard T&Cs for our legal review? I'll keep this as an internal proposal until we decide to present.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Director, Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Susan Lane <susan.lane@pacebook.com>, Tom Elliot <tom.elliot@pacebook.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 07:48:00 -0700
Subject: Draft v1.3 — Engagement playbook (updated milestones, evidence bundle ETA)

Hi Susan / Tom — attaching a revised playbook (v1.3) that incorporates your inline edits and clarifies the evidence delivery timelines Karthik outlined. Key changes: 

- Updated target sign-off: 2026-06-12 — 2026-06-18 window for signature, operational go-live targeted week of 2026-06-22 (final date depends on procurement signature).
- Evidence bundle: Redwood will deliver SOC2 excerpts + config checklist within 3 business days of Pacebook's written request.
- Added explicit owners for each milestone (Pacebook IT / Pacebook SecOps / Redwood PS / Redwood Ops).
- Added DocuSign link placeholder for quick e-signature once legal greenlight is given.

Action items for Pacebook: 
1) Confirm Susan Park as questionnaire owner and share her contact.
2) Confirm procurement target date (we will time DocuSign accordingly).
3) Approve v1.3 or share final redlines by EOD Friday 5/21 so we can lock the timeline.

Attaching: Pacebook_Engagement_Playbook_v1.3.docx, Redwood_SLA_summary.pdf

DocuSign preview: https://www.docusign.com/sign?token=abc123-pacebook
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/0953

Thanks — we’re ready to kick once you confirm the security lead and procurement timing.

— Naomi

Subject: Re: Draft v1.3 — Engagement playbook (updated milestones, evidence bundle ETA)

Naomi — appreciate the fast turn. Confirming a couple quick points: 

- Susan Park will own the questionnaire; I will introduce her to Karthik off-thread today.
- Procurement expects to be able to sign between 6/9–6/11 (they pushed the blackout to 6/1–6/8). That timing aligns with the DocuSign target you proposed.
- We approve v1.3 pending the SOC2 excerpt & sanitized network flow. Please send the evidence bundle as soon as available and we will route to SecOps for final review.

Exec signature readiness: I can confirm our VP of Engineering is available to sign the week of 6/15 if procurement finishes by 6/11; with that, final operational go-live target is 2026-06-22. Please send the DocuSign link and we will route for signature.

Thanks — Tom
Tom Elliot
Head of Platform Integrations | Pacebook
tom.elliot@pacebook.com
